item.title: One Thing.
item.content:encoded:
Just one little grammar issue I found.

Byers looks back up, Lopez and Bryans can be seen in front, They've nearly reached the bridge.

Should that be a full stop after front? Or should They've not be capitalised?

Incident Log I-3000-032

Question: Shouldn't '3000' be '3456', to reflect the current number of the SCP it is focused on?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Thanks for the heads up, I'm always confused by those specific rules.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Author, while the specifics differ, all the major English language style guides say to use numbers rather than numerals for small numbers (AP says "numbers less than ten"; MLA (and I think Oxford) says "numbers that can be written in one or two words"). I have edited this to use the AP rule (note that when a measurement is given with abbreviated units the numeral can be used "1 km" and "one kilometer" are both correct).

item.title: Welcome to the Nightmare
item.content:encoded:
Hey folks, so there was originally going to be an incident log appended to my 3000 entry which really expanded upon the fleshing out of the SCP. This is that incident log, or what it became over countless edits, and re-edits. I hope this really helps with some of the criticisms people originally had of my 3000 entry, and expands sufficiently upon the base concept. Thanks to Weryllium and Cyantreuse and Oboebandgeek99 for really helping me flesh out and solidify the concept.

I wasn't sure if I should place this on the actual 3000 entry page, or on it's own page due to the it's length. For the duration of the 3000 contest I determined it would be better to keep it here, but once the contest is over I will be reposting the article anyways, so I will integrate it then.
